topic: Positive-Target Cohort and Denominator Preservation in Leave-1-Last
problem_statement: If users with target rating < 3.5 are included in Recall or NDCG, denominator is zero or artificially diluted. If users with positive targets receive no recommendations and are dropped, metrics are artificially inflated.
solution_or_decision: Primary evaluation is strictly averaged over positive cohort (109,779 users in ML-25M). Users with empty/missing recommendations receive 0.0 across all metrics and are preserved in positive denominator.
evidence: 21/21 hand-calculated tests PASS. Pilot check on 500 users confirmed exact separation: 356 positive, 144 non-positive.
root_cause: Binary relevance thresholding requires non-positive targets to be segregated. Model failures must be counted as misses (0.0), not dropped.
